sources.publisher: Standard Chartered — RLUSD custody and planned LMAX collateral integration
claims: Standard Chartered says institutional custody for RLUSD issued on XRPL is live for eligible clients through its DIFC branch regulated by DFSA.
Standard Chartered is working with Ripple and LMAX to make RLUSD eligible collateral using a collateral-mirroring model that does not require transfer of the underlying RLUSD to the venue.
limitations: The live service is RLUSD custody, not native XRP custody.
LMAX collateral mirroring remains subject to documentation, testing, regulation and internal approvals.
No custody balances, collateral utilization or client counts are disclosed.
